title: Herdr: Agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal
summary: Herdr is a terminal-based agent multiplexer that allows users to manage and coordinate multiple AI agents from a command-line interface, providing a unified workspace for running concurrent AI tasks in the terminal environment.
problem_solved: Provides centralized management of multiple AI agents within the terminal, eliminating the need to switch between different agent instances or tools.
why_valuable: Enables power users and developers to efficiently orchestrate multiple AI workflows simultaneously in a familiar terminal environment, boosting productivity for AI-assisted development tasks.
